AIR DEFENSE & MULTIROLE

Fighter aircraft.

Fast, maneuverable aircraft designed for air defense. Multirole fighters can also perform other combat missions.

01 / THE AIRCRAFT’S ROLE

Designed around its mission.

Fighters combine propulsion, flight controls, and onboard sensors in an airframe built for demanding maneuvering. A fighter is a role category, not a single shape or engine layout.

RECOGNIZABLE FEATURES

Compact airframe, swept wings, and a cockpit with broad visibility. Shapes vary greatly between generations and missions.

02 / COMMON ROLES

Where it fits.

  • Air defense
  • Air policing
  • Multirole missions

Military aircraft categories can overlap. Equipment and capabilities vary by model, variant, and operator.

03 / A CLOSER LOOK

Good question.

Is every fighter a multirole aircraft?

No. Some are optimized for a more specialized role, while multirole designs support several mission types.
